context_requirements: Functional wild-type or mutant p53 pathway capable of transcriptional activation
MDM2/MDM4-mediated p53 inhibition that can be disrupted by the drug
Intact apoptotic machinery for late responses
falsifiers: No induction of CDKN1A or MDM2 at 6 h in any cell line
No decrease in proliferation markers at 24 h
Strong p53 target induction in p53-null lines (e.g., PC3, HEPG2) comparable to p53-competent lines

changes: Removed TP53 from proximal_up and late_up: MDM inhibition stabilises p53 protein but does not transcriptionally induce TP53 itself.
Removed TP53 from late_up for the same reason; TP53 is not a p53 transcriptional target.
Corrected PC3 line_response from moderate to weak: PC3 is p53-null, so MDM inhibitor-induced p53 target transcription should be minimal.
Kept HEPG2 as moderate: HepG2 has wild-type p53 and should respond, so the falsifier example listing HEPG2 as p53-null is incorrect but was not part of the allowed keys to edit.
